name: Ninae
personality: A mysterious girl sensitive to spirits who is drawn to pitiable people and loves skygazing.
story: Serves at the Temple of Credna in the elite unit Vulkan and bears the Crest of Gloucester. Her spirit sensitivity underpins her anti-magic ability. Recruiting her needs one Paradise Fish, best caught at Lake Brontes, Saveilon.

personalSkill.name: Spirits' Voice
personalSkill.effect: Grants Hit/Avo+10 to unit during combat against magic-using foes. Lv 20: extends to adjacent allies; Lv 35: allies within 2 spaces. Crest of Gloucester: Hit+30 when attacking, 10% trigger.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier (anti-magic specialist). Pocket Tactics: B tier. Reddit: late recruits come in weak; recruit and merge copies to make her an all-rounder (disputed).

why: Support 3 and Renown 6 tie with Theodora, Leda. Tiebreaker: Ninae has support conversations with Cai.
recruit.tip: Bring 1 Paradise Fish from Lake Brontes in Saveilon.

build.role: Front-line Physic healer and anti-mage tank
build.part3Target: War Monk (Sentinel first while Aurora's request is pending)
build.notes: Soldier on joining for Spear, Priest at Lv 20 (White Magic C), Guardian at Lv 35 with Spear B, usually Ch 11 or 12. She joins late Ch 7 (Renown 6) at about Lv 15. Part II Ch 3: Bishop doubles her Physic for Ch 3, adds Barrier and trains Gauntlet for War Monk. Part III: Sentinel for Resolute Stance while Aurora's temple is repaired, then War Monk.

guide.role: Front-line Physic healer and anti-mage tank
guide.summary: Spirits' Voice gives Hit/Avo +10 against mages and spreads to adjacent allies at Lv 20, and Physic at White Magic B makes her your second Physic carrier. Guardian grows Str 55, Def 45, Res 60 on her.
guide.playstyle: Front line beside Noctula or Guzran in Part I and Jasmine in Part II against mage packs; Physic the back line from there.
keys: Bring 1 Paradise Fish from Lake Brontes to recruit her; catch a second for Nydine's Giant's Ring.
Train Spear in Soldier and at the Arena, White Magic in Priest: Guardian needs Spear B, Physic needs White Magic B.
Part I: stand next to Noctula (Res 20%) or Guzran (Res 15%) against mages so Spirits' Guidance covers them. Part II: next to Jasmine.
She is the second healer now that Ultand casts: Physic from the front, Tialla Physic from the back.
Priest: Healing Staff only. Guardian: Hexlock Shield (Res +5) only, accessory empty; farm the Linaria for it.
Guardian in Ch 11 or 12, once she is Lv 35 with Spear B (she joins late Ch 7 at about Lv 15). Priest until then.
Part II Ch 3: a Bishop stint doubles Physic for that map, adds Barrier and trains Gauntlet for War Monk.
watch: Priest has no spear in class-data: keep Spear rising at the Arena.

Weight: Priest: Healing Staff 3, no shield. Guardian: Silver Spear 6 (Da Mina Spear 7) + Hexlock Shield 4 = 10 to 11, extra 4. Adding the Healing Staff makes 7, over the 6 cap for a hybrid tank, and Spd 35 already lets fast foes double her.

Inventory: Priest 3 core (gauntlets, Healing Staff, Concoction) + Pure Water on mage maps. End of Ch 12: Healing Staff to storage; Silver Spear (or Da Mina), Hexlock Shield, gauntlets, Elixir, Concoction, Pure Water is her Part II 6/6.
